due_when.clears_when: operator decides the minimum Stage-0 source-trade floor for the T3 threshold and #14272 (or a follow-up) carries it

origin.ref: manager-local independent review of PR #14272 (head f2a351d2), 2026-09-29 ~16:05Z, finding N1

what: [mandate][evidence-threshold][operator-preference] MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 T3 gate (#14272) derives a per-leg p10 threshold from Stage-0 records as thin as 2 source trades (T3_MIN_SOURCE_TRADES = 2, scripts/ops/mandate_resolver.py:310 on PR head f2a351d2). Measured on that head: 4 of 7 Stage-2 legs have < 20 Stage-0 source trades (ief 3, iaum 7, slv 11, trend_donchian_xrp_4h 16); ief's own evidence record says n_trades_oos=3 'is not a basis for a verdict' yet yields p10 = +12.06R. For the 3 positive-p10 legs the rule collapses to 'both 20-trade windows < 0'. Raising the floor makes those legs abstain (no T3 demotion path) until more Stage-0 data exists; leaving it keeps a weak-threshold demotion path. Goes to the operator with the #14272 mandate-text approval popup.
